topic: Google your own business: the 3 things to check
caption:
Pull up Google right now and search your own business name.
Wrong hours cost you customers. An unanswered review costs you trust. A mismatched category means Google sends you the wrong people.
Three fixes. Zero cost. Do it today.
Want us to audit what Google sees? DM us AUDIT.

copy.headline: Google yourself. Fix these 3 things today.
copy.check1: Your business name, hours, and phone are correct.
copy.check2: You have responded to at least one review.
copy.check3: Your category matches what you actually do.
